speaker: Patient
text: 72-year-old male. The patient reports a 6-month history of fatigue and an unintentional weight loss of 5 kg (11 lb) despite maintaining a good appetite. He denies any recent changes in his diet or physical activity. He takes no medications and does not smoke or use illicit drugs.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that history. Since you are a 72-year-old male with significant weight loss and fatigue, I need to check for lymphadenopathy in the supraclavicular fossa; please lift your arms so I can examine above your collarbones. Additionally, could you describe the nature of this fatigue—is it accompanied by night sweats, fever, or persistent cough?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue. I also have 5 kg unintentional weight loss over 6 months, Good appetite.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lymphoma. Given your age, unintentional weight loss, and fatigue despite a good appetite, these are classic "B symptoms" often associated with lymphoma. I have noted the physical findings; further imaging will be required to confirm the extent of involvement.
